cases.title: Checkbox 主要回调不重复
cases.given: 已有一个未选的受控 Checkbox，记录主要更新回调次数
cases.when: 分别点击控件、关联标签，并用空格激活
cases.then: 每次实际转换只触发一次主要更新回调；无外壳和label双toggle
cases.result: Label/Space activation and callback counters are covered by the actual native-control browser and component tests.

cases.title: 受控值回填不回声
cases.given: 父级控制checked/value
cases.when: 父级程序更新值并再次渲染
cases.then: 视觉同步，但不伪造一次用户更改回调
cases.result: Covered by the linked current component/browser regressions and recorded review scope.

cases.title: 聚合 mixed 与未知区分

cases.result: Known finite subsets expose mixed; empty/loading scopes are disabled and unchecked. Accessibility review here means source/DOM semantics, not screen-reader operation.

cases.title: 父级全选不额外提交

cases.result: SC-01 native serialization and the now-implemented SC-03 nameless master are both covered; only enabled real items enter FormData.

cases.title: Radio 键盘基本路径

cases.when: 使用方向键、空格、Tab和Shift+Tab
cases.then: 符合已定底座普通组模型；不额外提交；原生初始反向Tab差异记录而非假装所有浏览器相同
